meta.name: City on Fire
meta.description: A college student is shot in Central Park on July 4, 2003. The investigation connects a series of mysterious citywide fires, the downtown music scene, and a wealthy uptown real estate family fraying under the strain of the many secrets they keep.

videos.title: We Have Met the Enemy, and He Is Us
videos.overview: A shooting in Central Park upends the lives of a disparate group of New Yorkers.

videos.title: Scenes from Private Life
videos.overview: The search for the shooter begins—and the police are not the only ones looking for answers.

videos.title: The Family Business
videos.overview: Charlie finds a new family. Regan and William's old wounds are revealed. Keith is shocked by revelations about the shooting.

videos.title: Land of a Thousand Dances
videos.overview: Keith becomes a suspect—and begins to fear an even worse possibility. Charlie uncovers his first real clue.

videos.title: Brass Tactics
videos.overview: Charlie learns a secret. William finds himself back in the family fold—with dire consequences.

videos.title: Annus Horribilis
videos.overview: The Hamilton-Sweeneys' twisted past proves crucial to unraveling the truth.

videos.title: The Demon Brother
videos.overview: Charlie races to stop a new threat.

videos.title: In the Dark
videos.overview: A citywide power outage puts the investigation—and multiple lives—in jeopardy.

meta.slogan: A mysterious death. A best friend as the suspect. And a city on fire.
